generations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production original 2D action-RPG character six-keypose transparent sprite atlas.
Input 1 is the EXACT weapon + costume design reference: CH01_actions_front_v3. Input 2 is only the six-pose front-facing horizontal-sweep sequence and identity reference: CH01_secondary_front_v1.
Create a NEW front three-quarter view six-pose atlas replacing every old piston hammer with the identical mining battleaxe from Input 1: one broad single curved silver chopping edge, orange riveted crescent steel plate, black structural inset, a small flat squared hammer poll opposite the single blade, stout short leather-wrapped two-hand haft with brass socket. No gun or twin piston barrels. Preserve the stocky black-haired man's face, orange black work clothes, cream scarf, one hydraulic forearm, orange grate shoulder plate, boots, lantern and straps.
STRICT canvas/layout: landscape 1536x1024 RGBA, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 cells. Each cell contains exactly one complete character plus his ONE whole axe. Each silhouette, axe tip, boot, and strap must stay between x=48 and x=464 relative to that cell, y=56 and y=450; leave at least 48 transparent pixels beside each cell boundary. Smaller character if necessary; never touch another cell. All six characters have the SAME anatomical scale, around 330 pixels standing crown-to-planted-boot midpoint; crouching changes pose not size. Camera is elevated 3/4 front, hero targets screen-right, front of face and torso visible. Orthographic polished hand-painted game art with crisp edges and consistent light.
Reading order:
1 PLANT: wide planted stance, both hands on low axe across waist, blade to the right and below hands.
2 COIL: knees flex and hips rotate to his left, hands draw axe far toward screen-left at hip level, eyes still target right. Clearly stored torsion.
3 DRIVE: hips begin uncoiling, both hands drive the haft across belly from left toward right, blade accelerating laterally at waist/chest height.
4 CONTACT: weight transferred, both arms extend across body toward right, chopping edge presented toward target at waist/chest level; clear diagonal blade silhouette, no overhead motion.
5 FOLLOW: further shoulder/waist rotation beyond contact, axe follows horizontally past right side, rear heel pivots, axe still fully inside cell.
6 READY: recoiled low two-hand stance, axe angled down to right, returning balance.
This is a SIDEWAYS horizontal cleave, never a overhead slam. Have distinct coil/contact/follow body mechanics. Fingers wrap haft naturally, one hand by butt and second forward; do not fuse gloves or bend wrists backward. True transparent background with clean alpha. Absolutely no brown backdrop, floor, shadows detached from boots, glow, particles, trails, panels, text, cell borders, labels, watermark, or duplicate weapons. Preserve full axe and feet within each cell.

review.source_art: Both banks visually inspected at original size. Same original man, orange-black costume and single-blade battleaxe design; no remaining twin-piston weapon or cropped visible blade/boot.

review.packing: All final visible silhouettes belong to independent 512x512 cells. Some blade tips have 15px cell-edge margin rather than the requested 32px; actual neighboring silhouette gaps exceed 90px. Crop regions have no visible neighboring fragments.
